## Software

::: {.callout-note title="One release so far"}
Most of the lab's code is not public yet. Rather than list private repositories
that nobody can open, this page shows only what is genuinely available, and grows
as more is released.
:::

### [ml-guide-hdac](https://github.com/ai-drugs-hup/ml-guide-hdac)
[MIT licence]{.repo-tag}

A practical guide to building machine-learning models for histone deacetylase
inhibitor prediction, written for people in the lab and left public because it is
useful outside it too.
:::

[What we use]{.eyebrow}

## Methods and tools

The lab is deliberately not tied to one framework. What follows is what actually
appears in the lab's work, grouped by the question it answers.

::: {.skill-grid}
::: {.skill}
[Predicting]{.skill-head}

Molecular property and activity models in **PyTorch**, **scikit-learn**,
**XGBoost** and **LightGBM**; molecular representations from **RDKit** and the
**Uni-Mol** pretrained models; **SHAP** to interpret what a trained model is
actually keying on.
:::

::: {.skill}
[Docking and screening]{.skill-head}

**AutoDock Vina** for pose prediction and virtual screening, with **Open Babel**
for format and protonation handling, and **AlphaFold** where an experimental
structure is not available.
:::

::: {.skill}
[Simulating]{.skill-head}

Molecular dynamics in **GROMACS** and **AMBER**, with **ACPYPE** for ligand
parameterisation and **OpenMM** where a Python-native engine is easier to script.
:::

::: {.skill}
[Quantum chemistry]{.skill-head}

**ORCA**, **Gaussian 16** and **xTB** for the cases where a force field is not
trustworthy — charges, conformer energies and reaction-relevant geometries.
:::

::: {.skill}
[Making and measuring]{.skill-head}

Synthesis of hydroxamic acid and oxoindoline-based scaffolds, followed by enzyme
inhibition and cytotoxicity assays. The published record is the evidence here:
twenty of the lab's papers report compounds synthesised, and twenty-three report
biological evaluation.
:::

::: {.skill}
[Looking at structures]{.skill-head}

**PyMOL** for inspection and figures, because a trajectory that has not been
looked at is a number nobody should trust yet.
:::
:::
